title: Partner Churn & Retention Analytics
description: A sophisticated analytics platform that helps businesses understand and reduce partner churn while improving retention rates through predictive modeling and actionable insights.
features: Churn prediction algorithms to identify at-risk partners
Cohort analysis for retention tracking over time
Partner segmentation based on behavior patterns
Heatmap visualization of retention by partner segment
Automated alert system for high-risk accounts
A/B testing framework for retention strategy optimization
Integration with CRM platforms for unified partner data
